articles.title: The Tech Download: Will Jensen Huang’s return be the spark the shaky AI market needs?
articles.summary: Neoclouds have seen stocks plummet in recent months as investors question the sustainability of the AI boom. "While Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO is indubitably a boon for the markets and the overall AI trade, it does not assuage every risk and concern about an industry confronting a potential peak in its investment boom and moderating earnings growth." The early week rally was "largely driven" by Huang's return, said Violeta Todorova, senior research analyst at Leverage Shares.

articles.title: Inflation has shoppers hunting for value. That bodes well for Black Friday
articles.summary: Economic headwinds have made consumers more cautious — but new data and reports from retailers are painting a picture of robust holiday spending through Black Friday and beyond. High inflation, fluctuating gas prices and labor uncertainty have dampened consumer sentiment and contributed to a pullback in spending. Holiday sales are expected to top $1 trillion this year, but that growth is boosted by inflation.

articles.title: Chinese chip stocks notch biggest ever one-day gains as Beijing signals broader market support
articles.summary: Chinese stocks rebounded sharply on Friday after a rare intraday state media readout cheered investors as top policymakers pledged to expand the role of state-backed funds in supporting the market. The CSI Semiconductor index of 40 chip stocks climbed by 17.6% in its biggest single-day gain on record, surpassing the prior record of nearly 17% in late 2024, according to Wind Information.

articles.title: Private markets are more accessible than ever for investors. Getting out is another matter
articles.summary: Retail investors are lining up to back private funds. PwC research has found that 77% of fund distributors surveyed said access to private markets is becoming important or very important to what they plan to offer clients, but just 15% of asset managers said they provide comprehensive education for retail investors.

articles.title: SpaceX shares jump on alternative trading platform after Musk says he will expand on Trump Account share donations
articles.summary: Shares of SpaceX jumped 7.47% in overnight trading on Blue Ocean ATS after CEO Elon Musk expanded his SpaceX share-donation plan for U.S. stock exchanges were closed Thursday and are scheduled to close early Friday. The latest pledge follows SpaceX's announcement Wednesday that it would donate one share of its Class A stock to every active Trump Account, tax-advantaged investment accounts for American children, with Musk personally matching the gift.

articles.title: China’s factories are growing profits again, but the AI boom is picking the winners
articles.summary: China's economy has been running at two speeds, with AI-related manufacturing and exports powering growth while household consumption has been lagging. Commodity producers also saw sharp growth in profits as demand tied to renewable energy and AI pushed up copper and aluminum prices, Yu said.

articles.title: Trump demands probe into ‘record setting error’ after third-quarter GDP data gets massive revision higher
articles.summary: economy exhibited much stronger growth for the third quarter than initially estimated, showing that real GDP grew at a 4.3% annualized rate. "I would like to wish a Happy Thanksgiving to even those who issued fake Economic Numbers, just prior to the Election, and corrected them yesterday, three weeks late, showing that the GDP was actually 4.3%, versus 3.4%, A RECORD SETTING ERROR, and one so grave that it should be immediately investigated," Trump wrote.

articles.title: Nvidia chip buyers told to rule out Chinese renters to purchase GPUs, sources say
articles.summary: Chip sellers communicated the messaging to neoclouds after the announcement, which seeks to close an export controls loophole allowing Chinese companies to rent access to Nvidia's most advanced chips when hosted in data centers overseas, two people familiar with the situation told CNBC. Neocloud stocks have come under renewed pressure lately as investors questioned the sustainability of the AI boom.
